why: every case runs through these: the dispatcher sources portable.sh and paths.sh before any other engine file, and every case's main is made from the test pack, rules and hooks; a change to paths.sh's functions alone runs the case files of their callers (test-changed.sh funcsof)
wait.sh, what these cases test, is in core (every case waits through it); this area names the case file so a change to it alone runs it
card.sh runs each step of a card (brief, build, review, fix, test, landing), so every case that runs a whole card tests it, and case files split to stay under the CPU budget each count apart
no case runs `conveyor.sh product`: these cases test what product() prints, the product paths
the loop: nearly every case runs `loop run`; and the cases that load the engine as the run command loads it read this file's lib lines
every case's setup runs `loop state-dir` (tests/lib.sh), and the cases that call engine functions source the dispatcher with state-dir
